name: WireGuard Easy
tagline: VPN pour accéder à votre Pi
description: Serveur VPN WireGuard avec interface web simple.
notes: Redirigez le port UDP 51820 de votre box vers le Pi.
compose:
services:
  wgeasy:
    image: ghcr.io/wg-easy/wg-easy:15
    container_name: wgeasy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - INSECURE=true
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - SYS_MODULE
    sysctls:
      - net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
      - net.ipv4.conf.all.src_valid_mark=1
    ports:
      - "51820:51820/udp"
      - "51821:51821/tcp"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/etc:/etc/wireguard
      - /lib/modules:/lib/modules:ro

en.description: WireGuard VPN server with a simple web interface.
en.notes: Forward UDP port 51820 on your router to the Pi.
